introHtml: CPSkeystone bag clips are a trusted choice for businesses needing durable, functional promotional products. These clips keep chips, snacks, and other bagged items sealed tight. With customization options like full-color printing or debossing, you can add your logo to the 4-inch, 6-inch, or magnetic rip 'n' clip designs. Ideal for trade shows, employee gifts, or retail giveaways.
